primary_model: unchanged original stopped preference-adjustment economy, k=2
width_rule: width 16 for even seeds, width 32 for odd seeds; two tanh hidden layers
optimizer: Adam, critic .0005, actor .0002, batch 128, 3 critic updates per actor, float64, one Torch thread
primary_architecture: accessible-face critic and wealth-distance portfolio head, defined in paper; no optimal-value labels
primary_sampling: uniform full state-time domain with an additional 25% boundary-layer preference/lower-wealth samples
selection: retain and certify every predeclared checkpoint; no best-seed substitution
boundary_ablation: first seed, width 16, 800 updates, all-face hard Dirichlet critic with same invariant actor
arithmetic_crosscheck: all 18 frozen R14 library nodes, same rational quadrature and analytic formulas, independent MPFR basic and elementary arithmetic at 128 bits, directed conversion to binary64; this is NOT fresh policy generation
baseline_protocol: original economy, controlled Markov-chain and semi-Lagrangian state-space candidates at three refinements; keep discrete values separate from continuous-time certificates
structured_extension: coupled quadratic inventory diffusion in 4,8,16,32,64,128 states; neural two-mode feedback trained by Riccati residuals, ten fixed seeds, full-time interval verification
failure_policy: invalid enclosure or nonfinite training stops the affected run; no skipped cells; retain all failures and target misses
provenance: protocol committed before canonical remote experiments; source hash, input hashes, resource use and all stored models accompany results
